name: motion-blur
title: Motion Blur
description: Sharpen a mounting element in from an 8px blur while it fades — the <MotionBlur> preset built on the motion engine. Zero runtime deps (tw-animate-css).

aria: Preserves child semantics and accepts reduced-motion behavior from the motion foundation.
consumer: Ensure final text is sharp, contrast remains sufficient and reduced-motion users receive an instant transition.
limitations: Blurred text can be temporarily unreadable during animation.

exports.name: MotionBlur
exports.description: Sharpen a mounting element in from an 8px blur. Preconfigured `<Motion preset="blur">`.
